summary: The agent addressed unauthorized card usage and initiated a dispute.

intents.keywords: I got a bill for 8000 on my card, but...what's going on?

issues.reason(s): Customer reports a bill for an amount they didn't spend.

intents.actions of agent: Verified last four digits of card, pledged to freeze the card, initiated a dispute.
intents.Process Request: Dispute filing and credit freeze on the card.
intents.resolution: The agent will file a dispute and the customer should see a refund in 5-7 days.

intents.keywords: Thanks, but how long till I get...money back.

issues.reason(s): Customer wants to know when they will receive their money back.

intents.actions of agent: Provided an estimated timeframe for the refund.
intents.resolution: Refund will be processed in 5-7 days.
